fixed.summary: On the web the first frames after Play no longer stall on the HUD. Before the play gate offers Play, and once after og.render.compile, the engine draws a copy of the UI once, so the pipelines and glyphs the HUD draws with are made, and the splash counts them ("Preparing graphics n/m"): Play no longer opens while a HUD pipeline still compiles, which drew the HUD seconds into play. The copy is built a few times so the browser optimises the UI's code before the first played tick builds the real UI. The world, the UI, its stores and events are unchanged.
